## Secure Messaging

Protocols for asynchronous end-to-end secure communication, and the forward-secrecy, post-compromise, and metadata-privacy guarantees they offer.

- [Bit-dropping on the encapsulation key](/projects/proposals/index.qmd#bit-dropping-on-the-encapsulation-key) -- from *Triple Ratchet: A Bandwidth Efficient Hybrid-Secure Signal Protocol*
- [A subversion-resilient post-quantum X3DH](/projects/proposals/index.qmd#a-subversion-resilient-post-quantum-x3dh) -- from *Guarding the Signal: Secure Messaging with Reverse Firewalls*
- [Firewall rerandomization under an additional encryption layer](/projects/proposals/index.qmd#firewall-rerandomization-under-an-additional-encryption-layer) -- from *Guarding the Signal: Secure Messaging with Reverse Firewalls*
- [Modifying the Double Ratchet directly for anonymity](/projects/proposals/index.qmd#modifying-the-double-ratchet-directly-for-anonymity) -- from *Generic Anonymity Wrapper for Messaging Protocols*
- [Anonymity guarantees beyond message content](/projects/proposals/index.qmd#anonymity-guarantees-beyond-message-content) -- from *Generic Anonymity Wrapper for Messaging Protocols*
- [Session-handling in the vulnerable-message-set methodology](/projects/proposals/index.qmd#session-handling-in-the-vulnerable-message-set-methodology) -- from *How to Compare Bandwidth Constrained Two-Party Secure Messaging Protocols*
- [Capturing root-key forward secrecy in the vulnerable-message-set metric](/projects/proposals/index.qmd#capturing-root-key-forward-secrecy-in-the-vulnerable-message-set-metric) -- from *How to Compare Bandwidth Constrained Two-Party Secure Messaging Protocols*
- [CGKA security against fully active adversaries](/projects/proposals/index.qmd#cgka-security-against-fully-active-adversaries) -- from *Fair-Weather No More: Guaranteed Efficiency in Secure Group Messaging*
- [Per-party storage independent of group size](/projects/proposals/index.qmd#per-party-storage-independent-of-group-size) -- from *Fair-Weather No More: Guaranteed Efficiency in Secure Group Messaging*
